page.overview:
Who is Beast?

The Beast is the combined form of the five Dinobots. Like them, his strength is awe inspiring, far beyond the other combiners. Unfortunately, he is also a mindless monster, whose single impulse is simply to kill, regardless of allegiance.

The Beast was let loose upon the battlefield once, four million years ago. Fearing the uncontrollable savagery it possessed, Grimlock vowed never to let the Beast loose again. The Beast Within Part 2, Consequences

In the present day, with the Autobots moments from death (some several moments past death) Grimlock laid all his cards on the table and combined with his teammates into the Beast in an act of desperation. After killing the Decepticon combiners, and any Decepticon foolish enough to attack him, he turned on the Autobots. Optimus Prime attempted to reason with him, but to no avail. The Beast Within After significant casualties, the Autobots were forced to kill the Beast, and therefore all of the Dinobots, by leading him to fall off a cliff. The Beast Within Part 2, Consequences

The massive body count inflicted by the Beast's rampage left both the Autobots and Decepticons weakened, and meant they were unable to fend off Unicron's assault on Cybertron. With Primusgrievously wounded, reality-quakes tore the cosmos apart, and the remains of this particular reality were eventually devoured by the Hytherion. Ask Vector Prime, 2015/05/30
